{{Top|leg}}
The '''EB-89 Engine Maintenance Droid''' was as large as a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], and was armored to withstand the blast of a [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]]. EB-89s were among the diverse population of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] stationed aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Field Secured Container Vessel|container train]] [[Black Ice/Legends|''Black Ice'']].<ref name="BI">[[Black Ice (adventure)|''Black Ice'']]</ref>
